# JDK modules jlink puts into the bundled runtime (--add-modules), shared by all
# three packaging scripts. One module per line; # starts a comment.
#
# This is the common, cross-platform runtime. Optional classes in dependencies
# (notably Gson's java.sql adapters and Log4j's JNDI lookup) do not require their
# modules for QPlayer's code paths, so keep this list narrower than raw jdeps
# output. Platform-only additions belong in the corresponding package script;
# Windows appends jdk.httpserver for its SMTC cover endpoint.

java.base
java.desktop           # AWT/Swing tray, ImageIO (cover colour extraction), clipboard
java.logging

jdk.charsets           # GBK/Cp1252 fallbacks for netease payloads and local filenames
jdk.crypto.ec          # EC cipher suites — without it every netease HTTPS call fails
jdk.dynalink
jdk.unsupported        # sun.misc.Unsafe: LWJGL, Skija, gson
